title: UK album release: Magical Mystery Tour | 1976
content:
The Beatles’ Magical Mystery Tour album was released in the United Kingdom on 19 November 1976.

The soundtrack to the band’s third film had originally been released on 8 December 1967 as a two-disc 7″ EP. In the US, Capitol Records expanded the set with five non-Sgt Pepper songs released by The Beatles in 1967.

The full LP release was copied in other countries, and imported copies soon found their way into the UK. Popular demand meant that it peaked on the UK album charts at number 31 in January 1968, despite not being officially available in the country.

It was finally given an official release on this day. In 1987 the album became the standard version of Magical Mystery Tour worldwide when The Beatles’ back catalogue was re-released on compact disc.
